name: breakcheck-monorepo
description: A tool for comparing website states before and after changes

scripts.build: tsc -b --clean packages/core/tsconfig.test.json tsconfig.json && tsc -b && npm run copy-core-assets && npm run make-cli-executable
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.test:cli-bin: npm run build && npm run test:cli-bin:built
scripts.test:packaging: npm run build && npm run test:packaging:built
scripts.dev:cli: LOG_LEVEL=debug NODE_ENV=development cd packages/cli && tsx src/index.ts
scripts.dev:debug: LOG_LEVEL=debug NODE_ENV=development cd packages/cli && tsx --inspect-brk src/index.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run test:integration:built

author: Cleaver Barnes
